# Test data

Small CSV files in the formats of the owner's data files (see [data/README.md](../../../data/README.md)), for the
tests of the CSV readers and the imports. The owner's real files are never committed, so the tests read these
instead (design D5 of `add-ci-and-deploy`). The card, Cursed card and True Word rows are invented, apart from a few
names the specs already use. `sets.csv` is the list of the 12 sets that every player sees in the app.
